messages:
From: procurement@clearpathhealth.com

Cc: security@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supply-chain evidence request for vendor review

Hi Sergio,

We're wrapping up the vendor security intake for the ClearPath procurement committee. To complete the review we need the following artifacts by end of day 2026-09-10: 
- Current subprocessor roster with geographic residency and service categorization (CSV preferred)
- Most recent SOC 2 report (a redacted copy is fine)
- SIG/CAIQ responses or mapping sheet
- Short note on KMS residency and whether keys are customer-controlled or Redwood-managed

If you can confirm what you can provide and when, that would be great. Our legal team may follow up with a few narrow questions after we review.

Thanks,
Alice Jones
Procurement Lead, ClearPath Health
procurement@clearpathhealth.com

Attachments: none
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Copying Irene from InfoSec and Marissa from AE so we can bundle the artifacts and timeline. Quick clarifications before we assemble: 
1) Residency: do you need per-subprocessor country-level residency or only residency for providers that store customer data?
2) SOC 2 redaction: are there specific sections legal needs redacted for (contact details / IP addresses) or should we use our standard PII-redacted version?

We should be able to get a zipped evidence bundle (redacted SOC 2, SIG mapping, CSV roster, KMS statement) into your Drive link or via secure file share by tomorrow mid-day. If legal prefers DocuSign or a specific attestation form, let us know and we'll route.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supply-chain evidence request for vendor review

Hi Alice / Sergio / Marissa,

Attaching the artifacts we typically provide for these intake packets. Notes below on scope and limitations.

Attachments (zipped):
- subprocessor_roster_2026.csv — includes provider name, primary service (compute/storage/caching/KMS/monitoring), country of primary data processing, and whether access is production-only or also used for engineering/test.
- SOC2_Redacted_2025.pdf — standard PII redactions applied (customer names removed; network addresses redacted). If you need a more heavily redacted variant, tell me what to remove.
- SIG_response_2026.xlsx — our mapped answers and references to evidence artifacts (where we can’t provide full artifacts due to third-party NDAs we note that in the comments).
- kms_residency_statement.txt — short statement describing how keys are managed: Redwood rotates workspace-level keys; for hosted customers we manage keys in our KMS (AWS KMS) with HSM-backed enveloping. We offer customer-managed key options for Dedicated/Private deployments — the statement lists available models and our recommended patterns.

Caveats and items to expect in the review: 
- Some vendor contracts (third parties) include confidentiality constraints that prevent us from attaching their full sub-agreements; where that occurs we provide a provenance note and a contact route for the third party.
- SOC 2: our audit firm restricts distribution of full reports in certain scenarios; redacted report should be sufficient for an initial procurement review. If legal needs an in-person or brokered review, we can facilitate.
- SIG/CAIQ: our mapping points to internal artifacts (control owner runbooks, JIRA tickets, architecture diagrams). We can provide scoped exports on request.

Delivery options: we uploaded the bundle to the secure Drive folder (link below). If you prefer the artifacts via SFTP or a signed DocuSign attestation, let me know and I'll coordinate.

Drive bundle: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/clearpath-evidence-CPH-014
HubSpot record: HSP-2214 (for intake tracking)

I can also provide an abbreviated one-page summary of subprocessor residency by country if the procurement committee needs a quick snapshot.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of InfoSec — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supply-chain evidence request for vendor review

Alice — delivered the bundle and confirmed items per your ask. Quick summary of next steps: 
- Drive link (secured) contains: subprocessor_roster_2026.csv, SOC2_Redacted_2025.pdf, SIG_response_2026.xlsx, kms_residency_statement.txt.
- Irene offered a one-page country residency summary; happy to provide if that's useful for the committee.
- If ClearPath legal requires a brokered SOC 2 review or a DocuSign attestation, let us know and Marissa and I will coordinate scheduling.

Marissa, please add this delivery to the HubSpot opportunity and track any legal follow-ups so we can close the intake.

Thanks,
Sergio
